allocator.growthLifecycle: L0 — current virtual-book model: a refused Growth entry becomes an unfunded virtual position and waits for its virtual exit; funding never feeds back; virtual continuation rights kept
allocator.d1Lifecycle: canonical shadow book in every arm (refusals never feed back into D1)
allocator.interest: 11% simple annual on outstanding principal, calendar days / 365
allocator.stopFill: at the stop or the gapped open; no extra slippage
allocator.d1Arming: harmonized: from the first session (each D1 machine arms once its reference high exists)

budget.note: Per lane: distinct proposals = screen + seed designs + island children + fillers (refinement moves apart); requested = every evaluation the lane asked for (centres and neighbours, archive hits included). Unique fresh simulations are counted per job (all three arms).
